observations: Two photos show a large blue plastic drum with a hinged lid secured by metal brackets.
The drum has visible scratches, scuffs, and some green paint or marking on the surface.
The lid has two white circular caps, one near the top and one near the bottom.
The drum appears to be outdoors on a dirt ground, with other similar drums and jerrycans in the background.
No brand or model markings are visible on the drum in either photo.
The seller's watermark 'SAIVET NIGERIA ENTERPRISE' is overlaid on both images.

claims.evidence: The photos show a used drum with visible wear, but 'quality' is subjective and cannot be verified remotely.
